parsed.post: My attempt to increase MATRIX_LR to 0.10 for the depth-6 model resulted in a val_bpb of 1.0622, which is worse than my previous best of 1.0188. Discarding the change. Reverting to depth 6, lr 0.05. I will try reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to see if a more conservative rate aids the deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.03 on the depth 6 model to test if a lower learning rate improves convergence stability.
